snippet.title: Tong - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Tong is a fast paced, action packed food fighting PvP licking contest!

Play it for free on Mobile & Web!

Set in the grottiest fast food restaurants in town, battle your friends online in this chaotic, tongue-powered showdown! Licking as much food as your Tong can muster is the key to victory in this abrasive food fighter!

Customise your Tong with outrageous hats and show off your style in battle against your friends or total strangers online for the golden crown!

Music
Positive Funk Groove by Universfield 
https://freesound.org/s/770195/
